# Version 4.151.0
> **Managed-side performance and WASM fixes** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 ports several hot color/interop paths to managed C# and bumps Skia to milestone 151. Color conversion, premultiplication, and several HarfBuzzSharp/SKFourByteTag paths move from native calls to allocation-free managed code, and WASM gains Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11. It also fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData and removes an unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia bumped to milestone 151** — Updates the bundled Skia engine to m151, including several upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix syncs. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312))

## API Surface

- **GRContextOptions simplified** — Removes an unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions, making it easier to use from safe contexts. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Bug Fixes

- **Fixed native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) no longer leaks the native decoder resource on every call. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Color and pixel math ported to managed C#** — SKColor to SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply now run in managed integer math instead of round-tripping through native calls, reducing P/Invoke overhead on hot color paths. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **HarfBuzzSharp and tag parsing made allocation-free** — HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) now does a pooled UTF-8 encode instead of allocating, per-call char[4] allocations are removed from HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse, and SKShaper glyph results are read via zero-copy spans. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **Faster hex color parsing** — Optimizes SKColor hex parsing and adds ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads to avoid intermediate string allocations. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Platform

- **WASM gains .NET 11 Emscripten support** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 WASM and a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions early; also builds emsdk 5.0.6 libs with the new exnref exception handling and restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster regression. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))
- **Vulkan submodule cleanup** — Bumps the externals/skia submodule to drop the SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3788](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3788))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Ports HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) to a pooled, allocation-free UTF-8 encode and removes a per-call char[4] allocation from Tag.Parse, plus SKShaper now reads glyph results via zero-copy spans.
